items.title: EIB targets €30 billion in climate adaptation finance under COP31
items.one_liner: The EIB targeted 30 billion euros in climate adaptation finance under a new COP31 plan.
items.why: Offers potential funding pathways and financial metrics relevant to urban climate resilience projects.
items.action: Review EIB allocation criteria to understand how adaptation finance reaches vulnerable cities.

items.title: Dubai reveals landmark law on urban planning and construction
items.one_liner: Dubai has revealed a landmark law concerning urban planning and construction rules.
items.why: Provides a regional example of formal urban planning legislative updates in an arid, rapidly developing setting.
items.action: Examine the specific provisions of Dubai's new law for transferable regulatory concepts.

items.title: Wonju City caused indiscriminate development, audit finds
items.one_liner: An audit found Wonju City caused indiscriminate development by approving green space projects on formalities alone.
items.why: Illustrates governance failures in green space project approvals, relevant to data-scarce planning.
items.action: Analyze the audit findings to identify risks of superficial environmental planning approvals.

items.title: Five Decades of Global Peri-Urban Research Reveal Major Shifts
items.one_liner: A review of five decades of global peri-urban research reveals major shifts in sustainable planning.
items.why: Provides macro-level context on how peri-urban land-cover change and planning theories have evolved.
items.action: Consult the study to trace historical paradigm shifts in peri-urban sustainable planning.

items.title: China’s climate-resilient city pilots linked to higher grain output
items.one_liner: Research shows China's climate-resilient city pilot policies are linked to higher grain output.
items.why: Connects urban resilience planning with peri-urban agriculture and food production outcomes.
items.action: Read the study to understand empirical links between urban design and agricultural productivity.

items.title: COP31: Malaysia proposes 20% urban climate finance to communities
items.one_liner: Malaysia proposed that 20 percent of urban climate financing go directly to communities at COP31.
items.why: Highlights governance approaches regarding community-level access to climate funds in the Global South.
items.action: Track community-based finance mechanisms for insights on local-level resource access.

items.title: Thessaloniki to Expand Green Spaces With 19 New Parks
items.one_liner: Thessaloniki announced plans to expand green spaces with 19 new parks by June 2027.
items.why: Provides a practical municipal example of urban nature expansion and cooling infrastructure.
items.action: Note the timeline and spatial strategy used for urban greening implementation.

items.title: New Resilience4Ports framework helps measure climate resilience
items.one_liner: A new Resilience4Ports framework was introduced to help ports measure climate resilience.
items.why: Shows methodological approaches to spatial resilience metrics and assessment frameworks.
items.action: Examine the indicators used in the Resilience4Ports framework for transferable metrics.

items.title: City climate targets exceeding national ambitions
items.one_liner: Reports from the COP conference indicate that city climate targets are exceeding national ambitions.
items.why: Highlights the growing role of municipal-level governance and targets in climate adaptation.
items.action: Explore how decentralized urban targets compare with national policies in study regions.

items.title: San Diego’s Midway Rising project gets city council greenlight
items.one_liner: San Diego's Midway Rising project received approval from the city council.
items.why: Demonstrates municipal approval processes for large-scale urban development initiatives.
items.action: Review project documentation to see how environmental goals are integrated into approvals.

items.title: Applying the ‘4R’ concept in industrial redevelopment
items.one_liner: A study explored how circular economy principles ('4R' concept) apply to former industrial sites in Poland.
items.why: Offers insights into land recycling and brownfield regeneration relevant to urban land-cover change.
items.action: Review the Polish case study for methods applied to industrial land reuse.

items.title: Remediation of landfill leachate using microbiomes
items.one_liner: New research explores factors influencing microbiomes that detoxify leachate from municipal waste landfills.
items.why: Informs technical approaches to mitigating environmental pollution and managing urban waste sites.
items.action: Read the study details on microbiome optimization for municipal waste treatment.
